d:
双生之镜前，我们对视。
眸光交织，似命运丝线缠绕。
你我如镜中双影，一明一暗，却契合无间。
唇畔笑意轻扬，爱意在流转，这独特的羁绊，
于时光里晕染，开出只属于我们的浪漫之花。
彼之良·风铃【双生之镜/仿生2.2CF系列/155Mcm】

Before the Twin Mirror, we gaze into each other's eyes.
Our glances intertwine, like threads of destiny entangling.
We are twin reflections in the mirror, light and dark, seamlessly aligned.
With smiles dancing at our lips, love flowing, through this unique bond,
bathed in time's essence, it blossoms into romantic flowers ours alone.
Bezlya Campanula TwinMirror, Bionic 2.2CF series 155cm M ver
